intro.en: Custom wire harnesses using specified Panduit terminals, cable ties, identification and routing components, reviewed by exact part number, material and installation method.
intro.zh: 采用指定 Panduit 端子、扎带、标识及布线部件制作定制线束，并按准确料号、材料与安装方法审核。

knowledge.en: A component family name does not define a complete harness; control the circuit, conductor, route, installation and acceptance method together.
knowledge.zh: 部件系列名称不能定义完整线束，仍需共同控制回路、导体、路径、安装与验收方法。

notes.en: Provide original part numbers, wire range, bundle diameter, environment, drawings and the approved substitution boundary.
notes.zh: 提供原始料号、适用线径、束径、环境、图纸及认可替代边界。

delivery.en: Approve the component schedule, harness-board baseline, workmanship sample and inspection record before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认部件清单、线束板基准、工艺样品及检验记录。

lead.en: Control the complete component and harness system.
lead.zh: 控制完整部件与线束系统。
